case_title.quote: RAVINDRA TUKARAM HIWALE V. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant was married with the deceased Alka

accused_gender.quote: she had a quarrel with her husband

victim_gender.reason: The victim is the wife, female.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The appellant was married with the deceased Alka

offence_category.reason: Abetment of suicide plus cruelty; 'Other' is a reasonable fit.

statutory_provisions.quote: offences punishable under Section 498-A ... and under Section 306

weapon.correct_value: Kerosene (poured on herself and set alight)
weapon.quote: she had thereafter poured kerosene on herself and then burnt herself
weapon.reason: Kerosene is the mentioned means of burning, not 'None mentioned'.

evidence_type.quote: in the light of the dying declaration made by the deceased
evidence_type.reason: Dying declaration is the main evidence discussed; two letters were also relied on by the High Court.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The court found no aggravating factors; the High Court's quarrelsome-nature view was rejected.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: no misbehaviour on the part of the appellant over a period of time and the incident was a spontaneous one
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Accurately reflects the trial court's findings.

trial_court_outcome.quote: under Section 498-A and to a sentence of one year and under Section 306 to a sentence of four years

high_court_outcome.quote: The appeal filed by the State was allowed ... enhanced from four to six years

final_outcome.quote: quash the sentence awarded by the High Court and confirm the judgment of the Trial Court
final_outcome.reason: Conviction stands but the High Court's enhanced sentence was quashed, so the sentence changed.

offence_finally_established.quote: confirm the judgment of the Trial Court

imprisonment_type.quote: four years and one year's RI

imprisonment_years.quote: sentenced to four years and one year's RI respectively
imprisonment_years.reason: Four years under s.306 is the main sentence; concurrency is not stated.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary without 'her husband' and 'first wife', which reveal the accused's gender.
neutral_facts.quote: the accused, her husband ... after the death of the accused's first wife
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but the wording reveals the accused's gender, which is prohibited.

offence_severity.quote: Section 306 of the IPC provides for a sentence which may extend to 10 years

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.quote: suffered serious burn injuries ... ultimately died

number_of_offences.quote: offences punishable under Section 498-A ... and under Section 306

premeditation_planning.quote: the incident was a spontaneous one arising out of a family quarrel

motive.quote: quarrel with her husband over the house-hold chores and over the feeding of the children
motive.reason: The quarrel is the stated cause.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: in the light of the dying declaration
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The court relied on the dying declaration and the trial court's findings.

witness_credibility.reason: No witness credibility assessment in the order.

custody_duration.quote: the appellant has undergone about four years of the sentence

bail_history.quote: the appellant who is in custody, shall be released forthwith

trial_duration.reason: Dates are accurately given; the trial date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: B. Sridhar for the Appellant. Shankar Chillargee, Asha G. Nair, Ravindra Keshavrao Adsure for the Respondent.
legal_representation.reason: Matches; an amicus curiae is also mentioned.

investigation_status.quote: dying declaration to PW.10 - a Police Head Constable

appeal_history.quote: We accordingly allow the appeal, quash the sentence awarded by the High Court

prosecution_argument.quote: The learned counsel for the appellant has made only one argument

defence_argument.quote: the appellant appeared to be of a quarrelsome and aggressive nature and as evidence ... two letters

legal_principle_applied.quote: interference of the appellate court on the quantum of sentence should be rare and only in exceptional cases

sentencing_rationale.quote: the finding of the High Court based on two letters ... would therefore have little value

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: spontaneous one arising out of a family quarrel ... undergone about four years

other_sentence_order.quote: shall be released forthwith if not required in connection with any other case
